check.name: ck_viaje_solicitado_ck_viaje_calidad_min
check.definition: ((calidad_minima_vehiculo IS NULL) OR ((calidad_minima_vehiculo)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('regular'::character varying)::text, ('bueno'::character varying)::text, ('excelente'::character varying)::text])))

check.name: ck_viaje_solicitado_ck_viaje_centro_costo_despacho
check.definition: ((origen_tipo IS NULL) OR ((origen_tipo)::text <> 'despacho_manual'::text) OR (centro_costo IS NOT NULL))

check.name: ck_viaje_solicitado_ck_viaje_estado_cobro
check.definition: ((estado_cobro IS NULL) OR ((estado_cobro)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('pendiente'::character varying)::text, ('cobrado'::character varying)::text, ('facturado'::character varying)::text, ('pagado'::character varying)::text])))

check.name: ck_viaje_solicitado_ck_viaje_origen_tipo
check.definition: ((origen_tipo IS NULL) OR ((origen_tipo)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('plataforma'::character varying)::text, ('via_publica'::character varying)::text, ('qr_comercio'::character varying)::text, ('corporativo'::character varying)::text, ('despacho_manual'::character varying)::text])))

check.name: ck_viaje_solicitado_ck_viaje_responsable_cobro
check.definition: ((responsable_cobro IS NULL) OR ((responsable_cobro)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('chofer'::character varying)::text, ('propietario'::character varying)::text, ('tenant'::character varying)::text, ('comercio'::character varying)::text, ('empresa'::character varying)::text])))

check.name: ck_viaje_solicitado_ck_viaje_subestado_despacho
check.definition: ((subestado_despacho IS NULL) OR ((subestado_despacho)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('reservado'::character varying)::text, ('despachado'::character varying)::text, ('vehiculo_llego'::character varying)::text, ('pasajero_a_bordo'::character varying)::text, ('completado'::character varying)::text])))

check.name: ck_viaje_solicitado_metodo_pago
check.definition: ((metodo_pago IS NULL) OR ((metodo_pago)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('efectivo'::character varying)::text, ('tarjeta_debito'::character varying)::text, ('qr'::character varying)::text, ('transferencia'::character varying)::text])))
